basezap-agent.description: USDC tip quoting and calldata construction for BaseZap on Base. Get platform info, fee-split quotes, and unsigned transfer calldata for onchain tipping.

args.description: Tool-specific arguments. get_tip_quote needs {amount_usdc}. build_tip_calldata needs {recipient, amount_usdc}. get_platform_info needs no args.

output.description: Varies by tool — platform config, fee-split quote, or unsigned transfer calldata.
